title: F5: a portable export of one correction and its complete append-only event ledger
description: Built by clozn.runs.corrections.export_correction(). Carries the correction's current stored document (clozn.correction.v1 -- content omitted if it has been deleted, exactly as the live record reads) plus every event ever recorded against it, oldest first, never filtered or summarized: drafted/confirmed/disabled/enabled/deleted/undone lifecycle events, plus applied/conflict_lost events tying this correction to specific runs. Exporting never mutates the correction or its ledger.

run_id.description: Present only on 'applied' and 'conflict_lost' events -- the run this correction shaped, or was surfaced-but-outvoted for.

detail.description: Event-specific context, e.g. an 'undo_of' event sequence number, a conflict's winner_id/rule for a conflict_lost row, or a deleted_reason string for a deleted row.

correction.description: The clozn.correction.v1 document as currently stored.
